title: Orpheus extensions to an ontologySpecR bundle
description: Validates only what ontologySpecR leaves open. A bundle must satisfy both this and ontologySpecR.bundle.schema.json; between them they cover the whole file, because the base schema forbids additional properties everywhere else.

domain.description: What the engine needs to know about this domain. Without it the pipeline would have to guess which object type a document is fundamentally about, and guessing is how a general engine becomes a contract engine again. `primaryObjectType` is required of any bundle that declares object types, and checked in _domain_problems() rather than here: a bundle with no object types at all is the legitimate starting state of a corpus nobody has modelled yet, and the schema said that state was invalid.

primaryObjectType.description: The object type a document is fundamentally about. Deterministic findings are linked to its instance.

containerProperty.description: The property on child types that holds the primary instance's id.

valueProperty.description: Property on the primary type holding a comparable numeric value, for corpus comparison.

currencyProperty.description: Property naming the unit of valueProperty. Values are only ever compared within one unit.

documentTypes.description: The vocabulary the classifier is given. A closed list, because an open one produces a new doc_type per document.

scores.description: Composite scores over concepts. ontologySpecR has no equivalent, so they live here.

managed.description: Orpheus creates and owns this object type's table. An unmanaged type is read from a table someone else maintains.
